aboutGame.title: What is Survive the Killer?
paragraphs: Survive the Killer is a thrilling multiplayer horror experience on Roblox where players are plunged into tense, heart-pounding survival matches. In each round, one player is chosen as the Killer tasked with hunting down everyone else, while the remaining Survivors must work together to explore spooky maps, collect valuable loot, revive downed teammates, and escape before time runs out.

Featuring dozens of iconic killers, hundreds of collectible knives with unique particle effects, and an active trading economy, Survive the Killer combines suspenseful cat-and-mouse gameplay with rewarding progression. Whether you prefer sneaking through dark corridors as a cunning survivor or dominating the lobby as an unstoppable slasher, every match offers fresh challenges.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions about Survive the Killer codes, gameplay, killers, and knife trading.

items.question: What is Survive the Killer?
items.answer: Survive the Killer is a popular Roblox horror survival game where players either play as a terrifying killer hunting down victims or as survivors working together to gather loot, revive teammates, and escape before the timer expires.

items.question: How do I redeem Survive the Killer codes?
items.answer: To redeem codes in Survive the Killer, launch the game on Roblox, click the Twitter icon or Codes button in the lobby, type in an active code, and click Redeem to receive free knives, coins, and cosmetic rewards.

items.question: How do you win as a survivor in Survive the Killer?
items.answer: To win as a survivor in Survive the Killer, stay alert for the killer's heartbeat radius, crouch behind obstacles to break line of sight, rescue downed teammates, and sprint to the exit gates when the escape doors unlock.

items.question: How many killers are in Survive the Killer?
items.answer: Survive the Killer features dozens of distinct killers including Jason, Malvus, Grimsley, and special seasonal killers, each equipped with unique weapon skins, walking animations, and pursuit sound effects.

items.question: How does knife trading work in Survive the Killer?
items.answer: Players can trade collectible knives and weapons in the Survive the Killer trading area. Knife values are determined by rarity, event exclusivity, and community trading demand.
